stemMd: Choose the correct word: "The archive has kept ___ original wooden cabinets."
explanationMd: The cabinets belong to the singular archive, so the possessive determiner is "its." An apostrophe would create an incorrect possessive or a contraction.

distractorRationale.c: The singular archive is not referred to by the plural possessive here.
distractorRationale.d: This contraction means it is or it has, not the possessive determiner.
distractorRationale.a: The possessive its does not take an apostrophe.
